messages:
sam_product: Quick sync — ACME wants a VPC-only packaging path + an in-place upgrade story. They care about preserved public IPs and the ability to manage BGP on their side. Can we align on an MVP for the next sprint? @nina_field

nina_field: Chasing ACME netops now. They called out preserved egress IPs, optional nat-relay, and an operator-run migration option. Pilot target is ~6 weeks out from their side.

omar_eng: Technical constraints: true in-place upgrades require an operator shim + careful DB migration ordering. We can do a warm-standby migration that reduces downtime but it’s ~2 dev sprints work. Also need egress IP pinning to avoid customer firewall churn.

elaine_prod: Tradeoffs: if we defer full zero-downtime in-place, we can ship a slim installer + migration tool sooner. Customer is open to a staged migration if we commit to a tested rollback and SLA for downtime (<=10m).

sam_product: Proposed MVP scope for sprint: 1) VPC-only install image (slim), 2) optional nat-relay component, 3) migration tool for tenant state (docs + tooling), 4) documented rollback & canary plan. Defer managed BGP and full zero-downtime upgrade to next quarter. Thoughts?

omar_eng: +1. Need to add policy for KV cache invalidation during migration and an acceptance test: simulate 1k concurrent requests with cache warm. I’ll draft the runbook and the load test.

nina_field: ACME says IP preservation is the blocker — we must document the handoff steps and offer a netops call during pilot. I’ll secure a network engineer from their side for the pilot window.

elaine_prod: Also propose canary rollout policy: 5% tenants for 48h, monitor latency and error rate <1%, automatic rollback threshold at 2x baseline error rate. Add that to the rollout doc.

sam_product: Timeline check — if we start this week, can we get slim installer + migration tool into review by end of sprint?

omar_eng: I can land the runbook PR and the load test harness. Draft PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/merge/1234 — includes this quick test command: 
```
wrk -t8 -c1000 -d5m http://localhost:8080/generate
```

nina_field: I’ll write pilot comms and collect ACME L1 contacts. Also want a pre-pilot checklist: firewall rules, IP ranges, and support rotation.

sam_product: Cool. Action items: omar -> runbook & load tests, nina -> pilot comms & contacts, elaine -> add canary policy to rollout doc. Defer BGP work to retro. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] created doc: /docs/private/onprem/sprint-1759-mvp-scope.md

omar_eng: Added a note in the PR about migration idempotency and KV checkpointing; we should test failure during step 3 and validate rollback path.

elaine_prod: Will schedule a 30m handoff call with ACME netops once we have the runbook draft. Prefer Wed morning.

sam_product: Sounds good — will update the sprint board and tag owners. Closing this thread, we’ll do a quick sync after PR lands.
